partner_result.scope_applied: MSS two-part spectral-window transfer and ridge-leverage perturbation, specialized to two residual target-scale directions

new_claims.statement: If Q=a(X+m(Y))^2+Y^T S Y with one untouched original cap-one coordinate X, S has two eigenvalues |mu|>=s, and the residual projection onto |mu|>=s/39 has max diagonal <=1/32, then ||p_Q||_inf <= 28.4310144633/sqrt(|a|s).

A square-dominant 1/312-heavy coordinate transfers two Schur-residual spectral directions at scale (3-sqrt(5))/2; diffuse residual window gives density <813, while a heavy residual window yields a second residual coordinate certificate >=((3-sqrt(5))/2)/312; same-sign heavy residual scalar gives density <1586.

later_correction.effect: Refutes the owner-message proposed universal conditional three-dimensional spectral-projection density cap. Does not affect this run's ridge/square results because they preserve original-coordinate product structure and never normalize spectral fibers.

explicit_example: 65-variable full-rank Walsh-rotated indefinite form with residual spectrum +2,-2 and 62 tail eigenvalues +/-1/50; square-assisted bound <14.216 and full matrix s_3>1.78975.
next_step: Route an initial bank-dominant heavy row, or a square-dominant row followed by a residual bank-dominant/opposite-sign heavy coordinate, into a product-preserving grouped-coordinate smoothing packet without a vanishing local minor.
